race.title: Yorton Mares' Novices' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This has a very open look to it but MIGHTY FLEUR arrives here on a roll and with race fitness and chasing experience on her side, that may count for plenty as she tackles a step up in grade. Jubilee Alpha was just about the best of these over hurdles so it will be interesting to see what Faye Bramley can do with her, while Sunset Marquesa is another nice prospect over the larger obstacles. MIGHTY FLEUR JUBILEE ALPHA (IRE) SUNSET MARQUESA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Jubilee Alpha (5/2), Sunset Marquesa (4/1), Siog Geal (9/2), Piper Park (6/1), Mighty Fleur (7/1), Onefournine (8/1), Getawhisky (10/1), Merely A Detail (33/1)
